Construct design-aware resamples

Source: R/resamples.R
som_resamples.Rd

Construct design-aware resamples

Usage

som_resamples(
  data,
  method = c("full", "subsample", "group_subsample", "block_subsample",
    "leave_domain_out", "custom"),
  repeats = 50L,
  prop = 0.8,
  seed = 1L,
  unit = "group",
  domain = "domain",
  splits = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A som_data object.

method

One of "full", "subsample", "group_subsample", "block_subsample", "leave_domain_out" or "custom".

repeats

Number of repeated subsamples.

prop

Proportion of rows or sampling units retained for analysis.

seed

Random seed used to generate all splits.

unit

Metadata column name or vector defining groups or predefined blocks. block_subsample does not infer blocks from row order.

domain

Metadata column name or vector defining transfer domains.

splits

For method = "custom", a list containing analysis and optional assessment row indices.

Value

A som_resamples object.

Examples

x <- matrix(seq_len(120), nrow = 30)
data <- som_data(x, group = rep(paste0("site_", 1:10), each = 3))
som_resamples(data, method = "group_subsample", repeats = 2, seed = 1)
#> <som_resamples>
#>   method    : group_subsample 
#>   splits    : 2 
#>   analysis  : 24-24 rows
#>   assessment: 6-6 rows
